name: 49618-decode-16b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), SM90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One in-process vLLM engine, one process, no NCCL.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1 -- fixed, not a search seed -- bounded at 16 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 50% by completion: 8 warmup, 8 measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 1024 (min = max on both), greedy, 16 requests, `ignore_eos` set so every request emits all 1024.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating full-page answers for one user at a time on a single GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line at commit 2899dca8432d40632987b0ec24253a8fe6df2710.
# `trust-remote-code` is required, not decorative: `deepseek_v2` is not a model_type the pinned
# transformers knows, so AutoConfig cannot load this repo's config without it.
# Flat reader: a line starting with a space is skipped, so every key must be top-level and every
# value must fit on one line.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat
trust-remote-code: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
